# lumen Agent Context

> Start from the product contract and the local workflow, then the tests that
> judge them. There is no separate design tree: the `.rs` file is the authoring
> surface, and each module's `//!` block carries the rules it owns.

## Contract

- [README.md](README.md): product promises. `## Capabilities` is the contract.
- [STATUS.md](STATUS.md): current support, limits, and executable evidence.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): future outcomes and explicit non-goals.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): source-data, caller, runtime, and library boundaries.
- [docs/indexing.md](docs/indexing.md): schema, write, durability, rebuild, and activation.
- [docs/querying.md](docs/querying.md): query, result, facet, metric, limit, and hydration.
- [docs/migration-0.5-search.md](docs/migration-0.5-search.md): 0.4.x to 0.5.0 caller migration.
- [docs/protocol.md](docs/protocol.md): HTTP fact sources and discovery paths.
- [clients/README.md](clients/README.md): generated-client language differences and limits.
- [docs/gke.md](docs/gke.md): local and GKE support tiers, topology, placement, and production verification.
- [docs/client-integration.md](docs/client-integration.md): client profiles, workload projection, request mechanics, and source hydration.
- [docs/authentication.md](docs/authentication.md): current and planned KSA access.
- [docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md): Standalone and Managed activation.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): local edit and verification rules.

## Behaviour

- [e2e/](e2e): one file per externally observable case, run by `cargo test -p lumen`.
  `Cargo.toml` is the inventory --- `autotests = false` plus one `[[test]]` stanza
  per file, so nothing starts or stops running without showing up in a diff.
- Rules observable only inside the implementation stay as colocated unit tests
  under their `src/**` owner: `cargo test -p lumen --lib`.

## Commands

- Build debug: `./build.sh debug`.
- Prepare and verify a release: `./build.sh release`, then use `lumen llm --topic verify-release` for the canonical candidate-to-promotion lifecycle. If the tag-pinned promotion fails before public writes, do not rerun that broken route: use the authoritative `.github/workflows/lumen-release-recovery.yml`. It is a fixed-identity, one-time recovery for `lumen@0.4.28`, not a generic escape hatch. It cannot rebuild or move the tag, choose another identity, or bypass verification. Recovery tooling may land separately on `main`, but cannot change the frozen release commit, tag, candidate, or product bytes.
- Install: repo root `install.sh --project=lumen` dispatches to `./install.sh`.
- Test: `cargo test -p lumen`.

## Root Artifacts

- [llms.txt](llms.txt): this file. Hand-maintained. It was generated by the `aw`
  CLI until that binary was deleted; nothing regenerates it now, so an edit here
  is the whole of the change.
- [build.sh](build.sh): debug build and local release-candidate preparation entrypoint; it does not publish releases.
- [install.sh](install.sh): project-local install entrypoint.
